goal: Prevent memory corruption and crashes caused by queueing oversized outbound message types or payloads
Fail early with an RPC error in sendmsgtopeer instead of sending invalid payloads that disconnect peers
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (ajtowns, naiyoma)
Resolved objection: returning false in production would stall connections for minutes (mzumsande)
Addressed suggestion to bound copy size by explaining rejection happens earlier (naiyoma)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it fixes an out-of-bounds write buffer bug in V2 transport encoding
Also prevents aborts in V1 transport and disconnects from peers receiving oversized payloads
